decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's office offer that fits the move toward flexible workplaces, this desk system is likely meeting or only modestly missing aspirations and is worth retaining.
A chair family sits near the firm's design and craftsmanship core, so with organisational slack and strong complementarity to existing interiors it would likely be kept.
These floor cushions are more niche and may fall shorter of aspiration than core furniture lines, but their material fit and limited resource demands make continued trial still plausible.
The upholstered sofa is close to the established premium living offer and designer-led positioning, so management would likely continue it unless results clearly underperform.
A high standing table matches the firm's workplace and adaptable-interior direction, making it a sensible product to keep while demand for flexible use settings develops.
Although rugs are more distant from the historical core, this collection was presented as a strategic flagship, so management would likely tolerate some uncertainty before reallocating resources.
